consequences: Each project's hooks read as out of date once, until `sati upgrade` runs. The fish completion test runs only where fish is installed. Defaulting an omitted task id to the task the caller holds stays an idea.
context: The owner asked for the items left after 9j and a review of the whole command line. The earlier decision rejected a picker because it would change `task claim` with no id; a flag avoids that.
decision: `task claim --pick` lets a person choose from the ready tasks; it is a flag, so `task claim` with no id still claims the top one. A group typed alone prints its help (exit 2) and `sati help <command>` is `--help`. Command lists show the first sentence of a description. The git hook runner's message names `sati upgrade`. Validation text from the core is not reworded for the CLI.
title: Command-line review: `task claim --pick`, help for a group typed alone, hints name `sati upgrade`
